name: Qwen-Image-2.1-PE (PE-T2I and PE-I2I prompt rewriters)
purpose: Prompt rewriting for Qwen-Image-2.1. PE-T2I turns a brief image request in any language into a detailed English prompt plus a recommended aspect ratio; PE-I2I takes a vague editing instruction plus input image(s) and produces a precise, actionable editing prompt (cards).

license.name: Qwen Research License Agreement (release date 2026-09-20)

PE-I2I carries the same license name; its LICENSE file was not read separately. Verdict policy (README, 2026-11-19): this licence term does not lower tona_fit; kept here for an installer label.

architecture.kind: hybrid linear-attention plus full attention vision-language model: 32 layers, every 4th layer full attention, hidden 4096, 16 heads / 4 KV heads, vision tower depth 27 (config.json of PE-T2I)
architecture.recurrent: linear attention (config keys linear_*, exact kind not stated on the card)

variants.notes: four shards plus system_prompt.txt; output is a JSON object (rewritten_prompt, wh_ratio) after a <think> block; card sampling: temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, max_new_tokens 16256
output JSON has rewritten_prompt plus either wh_ratio or ratio_follow

pc-12gb.notes: BF16 18.84 GB does not fit; a 4-bit copy of 9B parameters would be about 5 GB (arithmetic, no quantized repo checked), but it must share the GPU with the image model

pc-16gb.notes: same; runs before the image model, or on CPU/RAM since it is a rewrite step

pc-24gb.notes: alone; not together with the image model in BF16

other: Diffusers QwenImage21Pipeline (consumer of the rewritten prompt)
engine_support.notes: The architecture is the one of the Qwen3.5 family, so a Tona Qwen3.5 backend would run it; whether llama.cpp runs this fine-tune was not checked.

strengths: Official companion for Qwen-Image-2.1 and its Turbo record: expands short or non-English requests into detailed English prompts with an aspect ratio
weaknesses: Long thinking block before the answer (max_new_tokens 16256 in the card example), so slow as a pre-step
No benchmark on the cards for the effect of the rewriting on image quality

tona_fit.reason: Only useful in front of Qwen-Image-2.1; the rewriter step could be done by any instruction-following LLM already in Tona, and no measurement shows the fine-tune helps.
blockers: no evidence of gain over a general LLM rewriter
